text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager duty alert — AP-NORTHEAST-1 region. Elevated 5xx + high p99 latency for Hosted API and multiple Dedicated pools. Trigger: error-rate >= 4% for 10m (prod).

devon (oncall): I'm on it. paging triage channel. Quick status pls from infra/rt.

sarah (eng-sre): I see sustained 5xx spikes from frontends hitting model-proxy in ap-northeast-1. Error traces show upstream 502s from our control-plane calls to AWS APIs (EC2 describe, autoscaling) and token validation latencies.

liam (infra): AWS console shows "Increased API error rates" for ap-northeast-1 — control plane throttling affecting EC2 and ELB APIs per AWS Health. Also seeing elevated latencies to our internal KMS endpoint in that region.

devon (oncall): obs-bot, any gaps in metrics/logs? can we get a quick correlation with ingestion?

obs-bot: Datadog ingestion errors observed 1800001100-1800001200 for ap-northeast-1. Some traces missing due to agent-side dropped spans; metrics pipeline partial.

sarah (eng-sre): That explains some missing traces. But application 5xx comes from failed calls to our HA control plane that talk to AWS (instance + eni ops) when routing requests to Dedicated capacity.

support (cs): Customer triage — which tenants are impacted? we have a few enterprise customers pinned to ap-northeast-1 Dedicated pools. Need list to notify.

devon (oncall): Support, I'll attach a short impact spreadsheet in a sec. Immediate mitigation options: (1) route hosted traffic away from ap-northeast-1 -> fallback region eu-west-1/us-west-2 via smart-routing; (2) promote cross-region replicas for Dedicated pools or failover to standby capacity; (3) throttle large-batch requests and reduce max tokens to limit downstream load; (4) enable cached responses for common prefixes.

liam (infra): Can push an emergency routing override to the edge via our router config. Doing that now — will direct new traffic to eu-west-1 for model-family: redwood-std and redwood-xl. Existing in-flight requests continue.

devon (oncall): Execute with safe rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Notify if latency improves.

liam (infra): rollout started:
```
# router override
route-policy set --region ap-northeast-1 --fallback eu-west-1 --weight 10 --model-family redwood-std,redwood-xl
```

sarah (eng-sre): Also disabling autoscaling actions that require AWS API calls in ap-northeast-1 to avoid exacerbating control-plane rate limits — set autoscale.pause=true for those pools.

devon (oncall): Good. Also roll canary to shift Dedicated pool allocation:
```
# allocate standby pool in eu-west-1
dedicated-ctl create-standby --region eu-west-1 --size small --tags emergency=ap-failover
```

support (cs): Notifying affected customers with initial summary: "We are seeing elevated errors in AP-Northeast-1 due to AWS API instability; we have initiated cross-region failover and will update in 30 minutes."

obs-bot: Metrics update: after 10% shift p50/p95 improved for Hosted API; error-rate dropped from 4.3% -> 2.1%.

devon (oncall): Continue incremental shift. Sarah, can you confirm whether auth provider (third-party) is contributing? I saw token validation latencies in traces.

sarah (eng-sre): We observed Okta token introspect latency spike (~1.2s) for some requests — appears correlated with auth endpoint calls routed via ap-northeast-1. But primary root cause still AWS API throttling causing control-plane ops to fail.

liam (infra): Reached out to AWS support: case #987654321. They confirmed "service disruption impacting certain control plane API calls in ap-northeast-1" and that engineers are investigating. ETA unclear.

devon (oncall): Add observability vendor to ticket thread — Datadog (obs-bot) shows delayed traces and ingestion backpressure; confirm logs are being persisted to our S3 backup.

obs-bot: Logs are being archived to S3 (backup-bucket) — ingestion to Datadog delayed but raw logs intact for forensics.

sarah (eng-sre): Customer impact assessment (interim):
- Hosted API: ~6% of global requests previously served from ap-northeast-1; after routing override reduced end-user errors to ~1.5% globally.
- Dedicated pools: 4 enterprise tenants pinned to ap-northeast-1 experiencing degraded throughput and intermittent 5xx, now on failover standby but throughput reduced ~30% for those tenants.
- Auth provider: Okta latencies increased but not the primary error source.

devon (oncall): Handoff time incoming — I'm going offline in ~20m. Sarah, please take on-call for incidents channel after 1800003000. I'll post a formal handoff note.

sarah (eng-sre): Ack, I'll take over. Keep me posted if AWS gives an ETA.

devon (oncall): Handoff: current state summary to oncoming oncall:
- Issue: AWS control-plane API errors in ap-northeast-1 -> elevated 5xx for Hosted & Dedicated.
- Actions taken: emergency edge routing override (10%->50%->in-progress), autoscaling pause in region, created standby Dedicated in eu-west-1, support notified customers, FAQ posted to status page.
- Next steps for oncall: continue traffic shift to restore p99 targets, monitor Dedicated pool failover health, coordinate with AWS & Datadog, prepare rollback if new region issues arise.

sarah (eng-sre): I'm monitoring the routing rollout. Current weights: 10% -> 60% so far. p95 in ap-northeast-1 still high for legacy endpoints.

support (cs): Customer comms update sent to affected tenants (ticket refs: TKT-1123, TKT-1124, TKT-1125). We offered temporary dedicated failover credits and asked customers to contact support for session-level impacts.

liam (infra): AWS updated status: "Mitigation in progress; control-plane API call rate reduced after internal throttling adjustments". They recommend gradual retry/backoff from customers.

obs-bot: Final metric snapshot at 1800004500: Hosted API error-rate now 0.9% global; ap-northeast-1 localized error-rate 2.3% but traffic volume reduced due to failover.

devon (oncall): Thanks team. I'm handing off completely to Sarah at 1800003000. If AWS declares full recovery, we'll reverse routing and unpause autoscaling after controlled tests.

sarah (eng-sre): Affirmative. I'll keep this thread updated with timeline for full recovery and final RCA items.

support (cs): Marking impacted customers for follow-up and post-incident review.

incidents-bot: Incident record created: INC-2026-APNE1-001. Severity: Sev2. Timeline doc: http://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-APNE1-001

sarah (eng-sre): Closing note for now: continue to monitor AWS Health, Datadog ingestion, and Okta latencies. We'll open a postmortem after stabilization. :white_check_mark:
